blocks.title: Explain the important decision
blocks.text: Initialise the accumulator once. Each iteration changes total; i++ then advances the counter. Test i <= 3 before every pass.

blocks.title: Worked example · Trace an accumulator
blocks.text: int total = 0; for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) total += i;

blocks.title: Worked example · Initialise and trace pass one
blocks.text: Initially total=0 and i=1. The test 1<=3 is true; total becomes 1, then i becomes 2.

blocks.title: Worked example · Trace the remaining passes
blocks.text: At i=2, total becomes 1+2=3; i becomes 3. At i=3, total becomes 3+3=6; i becomes 4.

blocks.title: Problem 1
blocks.text: for i = 0 to 3 exclusive, how many iterations?
